name: Jieduanqi Hunyin
source:
A dark otome VN where you will walk a perilous tightrope between desire and morality. Will you melt the ice of your frozen husband, or fall into the gentle trap of the boy next door? Will you sink into a tangled, three-way descent, or break free from everything to claim your ultimate freedom?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4860780/Marriage_in_Withdrawal/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
这是一部暗黑向乙女视觉小说，你将在欲望与道德之间危险的钢丝上步步惊心。你究竟会融化冰山丈夫心中的坚冰，还是坠入邻家男孩温柔的陷阱？是沉沦于纠缠不清的三人旋涡，还是彻底挣脱一切束缚，夺回属于你的终极自由？

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4860780/Marriage_in_Withdrawal/]Steam[/url]]
